title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: FOLDED LEAVES (organic) — user explicitly chose this direction over the earlier Hail Mary brief. User's words: 'i like the folded leaves, be bolder and instead of one piece of leaf, organic combination of different leaf-twirl structures.' Iterations should: (1) DROP the single-stem L-system; build an ARRANGEMENT of multiple folded-leaf elements — like a small bouquet, a fern's mid-uncurling, a clutch of curling autumn leaves caught in a gust, or a spiral of palm-fronds. (2) BE BOLDER — increase the form's footprint to ~40-60% of the frame, exaggerate twirl curvature, layer 5-9 distinct leaf-twirl elements at varying scale and rotation. (3) Each leaf-twirl is a SHEET geometry (PlaneGeometry / curved BufferGeometry strip), not a tree skeleton. Use a calligraphic mid-vein + curling edge — fern-uncurling, palm-frond, or autumn-leaf-twist vocabulary. (4) BUG TO REMOVE: the current piece has a barbell/dumbbell render artifact at the end of the structure — two pale dots connected by a vertical line. Eliminate it. (5) Palette stays warm-amber on near-black; restraint in motion.

threejs_review.directive: Replace CPU particles with InstancedMesh (12k-60k instances). Use webgl_instancing_dynamic pattern: one leaf-quad geometry instanced per particle, orient via matrices, animate scale/rotation in loop. Unlocks 10x density, richer spatial depth.
